ns2:course.label: First-Year Gies Scholar Seminar
ns2:course.description: Introduction to business and an overview of the role of the Gies College of Business and the University of Illinois in providing opportunities for undergraduates to prepare to become business leaders. Introduction to the Gies Scholar Program, a leadership program for approximately 40 incoming first-year students in Gies College of Business. Students will begin to work as a team to use leadership in service to all undergraduates in Gies College of Business. Credit is not given towards graduation for both BUS 115 and BUS 120. Prerequisite: First-year student in the Gies Scholar Program.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given towards graduation for both BUS 115 and BUS 120. Prerequisite: First-year student in the Gies Scholar Program.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Gies College of Business.
